coverage_adjudication.grading_caveat: The abstract identifies “high-grade” prostate cancer but does not specify the Gleason score, Grade Group, stage, or other criteria used to define it.

exposures.supporting_excerpt: Fiber intake was not associated with PC risk (all p-trends > 0.55). Higher carbohydrate intake was associated with reduced risk of high-grade (p-trend = 0.016), but not low-grade PC (p-trend = 0.593).
exposures.endpoint_definition: No aggressive endpoint was analyzed for total dietary fiber intake; its reported endpoint was general prostate cancer risk.
exposures.reason: Fiber is discussed only for overall prostate cancer risk. The high-grade finding concerns carbohydrate intake and cannot be transferred to total dietary fiber intake.
